elements.label: Figure 4.12
elements.description:
Stacked bar chart (100% stacked, y-axis 'Share (%)', 0–100) showing the Shapley decomposition of the dissimilarity index for education and health outcomes. Four panels, each with bars for Enrolled in school; On-time education completion (Some primary, Primary, Lower secondary, Upper secondary); and Health (Access to flush toilet, Access to safe water, Access to health insurance). Legend series: Child gender (female, male), Region, Urban or rural, Kinh or ethnic minority, HH age, HH gender, HH education, HH wealth quintile. Values below are approximate readings (~) from the bar segments, not printed values.

Set 1: Child circumstances (gender, region): Enrolled in school: child gender ~10, region ~82, urban or rural ~8. Some primary: child gender ~11, region ~87, urban ~2. Primary: child gender ~6, region ~94, urban ~0. Lower secondary: child gender ~23, region ~74, urban ~3. Upper secondary: child gender ~14, region ~52, urban ~34. Access to flush toilet: child gender ~4, region ~62, urban ~34. Access to safe water: child gender ~1, region ~55, urban ~44. Access to health insurance: child gender ~1, region ~70, urban ~29.

Set 2: Parental circumstances: Enrolled in school: Kinh ~37, HH age ~13, HH gender ~8, HH education ~42. Some primary: Kinh ~16, HH age ~31, HH gender ~5, HH education ~48. Primary: Kinh ~52, HH age ~8, HH gender ~15, HH education ~25. Lower secondary: Kinh ~56, HH age ~19, HH gender ~11, HH education ~14. Upper secondary: Kinh ~56, HH age ~1, HH gender ~7, HH education ~36. Access to flush toilet: Kinh ~76, HH age ~3, HH gender ~2, HH education ~19. Access to safe water: Kinh ~19, HH age ~4, HH gender ~13, HH education ~64. Access to health insurance: Kinh ~64, HH age ~9, HH gender ~2, HH education ~26.

Set 3: Parental circumstances + wealth: Enrolled in school: Kinh ~13, HH age ~6, HH education ~18, HH wealth quintile ~63. Some primary: Kinh ~8, HH age ~20, HH gender ~4, HH education ~29, HH wealth ~39. Primary: Kinh ~14, HH age ~4, HH gender ~3, HH education ~8, HH wealth ~71. Lower secondary: Kinh ~21, HH age ~11, HH gender ~6, HH education ~5, HH wealth ~57. Upper secondary: Kinh ~21, HH age ~2, HH gender ~3, HH education ~17, HH wealth ~58. Access to flush toilet: Kinh ~33, HH gender ~2, HH education ~9, HH wealth ~55. Access to safe water: Kinh ~9, HH gender ~8, HH education ~29, HH wealth ~53. Access to health insurance: Kinh ~51, HH age ~6, HH education ~14, HH wealth ~29.

Set 4: All circumstances: Enrolled in school: child gender ~3, region ~38, Kinh and other segments ~11, HH wealth quintile ~37 (top segment). Some primary: region ~31, Kinh ~6 to 12, HH education ~7, HH wealth ~27. Primary: region ~35, HH wealth ~43. Lower secondary: child gender ~8, region ~38, Kinh ~12, HH wealth ~40. Upper secondary: child gender ~5, region ~18, urban or rural ~9, Kinh ~16, HH wealth ~40. Access to flush toilet: child gender ~1, region ~24, urban or rural ~11, Kinh ~21, HH education ~6, HH wealth ~35. Access to safe water: region ~40, urban or rural ~23, HH wealth ~19. Access to health insurance: region ~34, urban or rural ~14, Kinh ~21, HH education ~7, HH wealth ~19.

Pattern: region and HH wealth quintile dominate the all-circumstances set, while parental/household characteristics (HH education, HH age) carry large shares in the enrollment and sanitation panels, and the child-gender and urban/rural shares are small for most outcomes. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2020. Note: See Table A.4.1.1 for values. HH = household head.
